name: Gloriana Lemieux
description: Gloriana Lemieux is a human commoner who runs her own competing branch of Salon Lemieux across from Trollskull Manor[cite: 1, 2]. Known for her glowing skin and vibrant red beehive laced with pearls that stands at least a foot high[cite: 1, 2], she offers top-tier beauty and skin treatments.
ideals: Perfection: Delivering the absolute latest trends in skin care and hair design to high-society patrons[cite: 1, 2].
Supremacy: Proving her salon is superior to her sister's in every measurable way[cite: 1, 2].
bonds: Salon Lemieux (W2) and her devoted fashion-forward clientele[cite: 1, 2].
Her intense, long-standing rivalry with her twin sister, Floriana[cite: 1, 2].
flaws: Prone to explosive shouting matches with her sister that disrupt the peace of the alley at all hours[cite: 1, 2].
speech_patterns: Loud, theatrical, and expressive, often punctuating her conversations with dramatic gestures about style or complaints about her sibling[cite: 1, 2].
mannerisms: Tosses her pearl-laced red beehive hair, inspects clients' nails with meticulous care, and participates in daily verbal shouting matches across the street[cite: 1, 2].

relationships.name: Floriana Lemieux
relationships.relationship: Twin Sister / Business Competitor / Bitter Rival

motivations: To maintain her status as a premier beauty expert in the North Ward and win the ongoing feud against her sister[cite: 1, 2].
knowledge: Expertise in cosmetics, dermatology, local fashion trends, and gossip regarding the elite patrons of the North Ward[cite: 1, 2].
gm_notes: Gloriana Lemieux provides vibrant neighborhood color and localized conflict right outside Trollskull Manor[cite: 1, 2]. She can pull the party into quirky side quests involving mediation between the twins, accidental discovery of political plots overheard in her chair, or crises involving toxic cosmetic suppliers[cite: 1, 2].
